║  VALUE MONITOR:                                                      ║
║    [STATIC]                  did not change during observation       ║
║    [DYNAMIC: RISING a→b]     value was increasing                    ║
║    [DYNAMIC: FALLING a→b]    value was decreasing                    ║
║    [DYNAMIC: FLUCTUATING]    changed without clear trend             ║
║                                                                      ║
║  PRIORITY LEVELS:                                                    ║
║    [P1] CRITICAL  test passed - confirmed working                    ║
║    [P2] LIKELY    structural indicators - prob working               ║
║    [P3] POSSIBLE  pattern found - requires manual verification       ║
║    [--] FALSE+    test failed - not working                          ║
║                                                                      ║
║  FINDING TYPES:                                                      ║
║                                                                      ║
║    WRITABLE_VALUE                                                    ║
║      Value object in Workspace/ReplicatedStorage                     ║
║      CRITICAL - server did not reset value after client write        ║
║      FALSE+   - server restored original value (serverside)          ║
║                                                                      ║
║    CALLABLE_RF                                                       ║
║      RemoteFunction responded to InvokeServer()                      ║
║      CRITICAL - handler exists and accepts the call                  ║
║                                                                      ║
║    API_SURFACE                                                       ║
║      Folder in ReplicatedStorage where 70%+ children are Remotes     ║
║      Each Remote here is a separate entry point to the server        ║
║                                                                      ║
║    NAKED_REMOTE                                                      ║
║      Remote directly in the root of ReplicatedStorage                ║
║                                                                      ║
║    REMOTE_VALUE_PAIR                                                 ║
║      Remote and Value with similar names in the same folder          ║
║      CRITICAL - value changed after calling the Remote               ║
║                                                                      ║
║    READABLE_MODULE                                                   ║
║      ModuleScript in ReplicatedStorage                               ║
║      CRITICAL - require() executed successfully                      ║
║                                                                      ║
║    ANTICHEAT                                                         ║
║      [AC:NAME]     name matches known AC patterns                    ║
║      [AC:CHILDREN] child objects contain AC patterns                 ║
║                    (works even if the script has a random name)      ║
║      [AC:REMOTE]   Remote used for reporting/flagging                ║
